exposure: Transversus abdominis plane (TAP) block with bupivacaine and dexmedetomidine
Transversus abdominis plane (TAP) block with bupivacaine alone
outcome: Time to first dose of rescue analgesia
Total dose of opioid requirement in the first 24-hour post-Caesarean section
Number of patients requiring opioids as rescue analgesia
cohort: The study included ASA I and II parturient with no comorbidities admitted for elective Caesarean section.
finding: The addition of dexmedetomidine to bupivacaine in TAP block significantly prolonged the time to first rescue analgesia and reduced the total opioid requirement in the first 24 hours post-Caesarean section.
